liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Mississippi Half Step** (1 review): Reviewer considers this performance one of the year's greatest, alongside May 7 and June 9 [7]
- **Estimated Prophet** (1 review): The jam into Eyes is cited as one of the best heard by the reviewer [8]
- **Eyes of the World** (1 review): The reviewer singles out this jam as particularly amazing during the concert [7]
- **He's Gone** (1 review): Reviewer calls this performance one of the best they have heard from the band [12]
- **Not Fade Away** (1 review): High-energy performance features a ten-minute instrumental jam before vocals begin [8]

## The recordings

- **gd77-09-03.sbd.unk.276.sbefixed.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 20 songs; 171 min; rated 4.51/5 by 53 [1]
- **gd1977-09-03.aud.wagner.minches.91650.flac16**: audience recording; 19 songs; 196 min; rated 4.29/5 by 14 [5]
- **gd1977-09-03.131317.mtx.dusborne.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 19 songs; 199 min; rated 4.08/5 by 13 [2]
- **gd1977-09-03.aud.102409.flemming.berger.flac24**: audience recording; 19 songs; 193 min; rated 4.74/5 by 23 [3]

## Around the show

- Donna performs a great shriek after the first verse of the song [8]
- Attendees had to park miles away and walk to the venue entrance [11]
- The band played for an audience of more than 150,000 people [12]
- The day was the hottest and thirstiest the reviewer had ever experienced [14]
- Helicopters were present amidst the total mayhem of that day [14]
- 110,000 people attended in a muddy field with temperatures in the high 90s [16]
- The band left the stage after a few tunes to take salt tablets [16]
- Pregnant women were lifted out by a helicopter due to the sea of mud [18]
- Reviewer suggests trying June 8, 1977, for a better Eyes of the World performance [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd77-09-03.sbd.unk.276.sbefixed.shnf**: source: Soundboard [1]. Also: The show was simulcast over FM, resulting in many good tapes circulating for years; Two-track pre-FM reel transferred to DAT and then CD-R, except for the encore; Disc one, track one and two are apparently really from April 27, 1977 [1][11]
- **gd1977-09-03.aud.wagner.minches.91650.flac16**: taped by Bob Wagner; transferred by David Minches; source: 2 Sony ECM 270s> Sony TC-158 [5]. Also: Unknown mics recorded to JVC KD-1636 portable cassette deck using Maxell UD-90 cassettes [5]
- **gd1977-09-03.131317.mtx.dusborne.flac16**: transferred by Matrix by Dave Usborne; source: 2 Source Matrix by Dusborne; Soundboard (shnid:000276) Source: Two-track Pre-FM reel > DAT > CD-R, except for (terrapin), which is unknown AUD and Audience… [2]
- **gd1977-09-03.aud.102409.flemming.berger.flac24**: taped by Ken Flemming; transferred by Rob Berger; source: aud cassette master, tc-153, maxell ud-c90's, dolby b [3]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Raceway Park - September 3, 1977](https://www.dead.net/show/september-3-1977) [20]
